ablations.any_instance_only: At least one instance meets the full instantaneous predicates; the all-required-instance check omitted.
ablations.body_origin_only: Naive single-point containment in the bin frame, no corner/margin/contact/speed/dwell checks. The native body origin is the bottom centre, not an estimated semantic object centre.
ablations.geometry_only: All actual collision corners contained; support, speed, release and dwell omitted.
ablations.without_dwell: Full instantaneous native predicates; continuous dwell omitted.
ablations.without_speed: Full native predicates and continuous dwell, omitting linear/angular speed checks.

goal_semantics: All required collision volumes inside bin, floor-supported, released, below velocity limits continuously for recipe dwell.
negative_controls: Gravity disabled only for declared rim-overhang and unsupported stationary counterexamples. Moving case has a declared initial 0.3m/s linear velocity and zero authored contact friction. No pose, velocity or external-force overwrite during stepping.
scope: Passive, original rigid task-scene and independent completion checks. The native PiPER holds home; no learned grasp, image-based perception, shoe deformation or physical-robot transfer is evaluated.
timing_scope: One CPU worker. Per-case elapsed includes compile, validation, all recorded native steps, geometry, compression and case output writes. run() total includes execution and final output writes; run_benchmark() additionally records preparation plus execution in full-wall-timing.json. No camera, training, network or physical actuators.
